examples.title: Confirmation
examples.description: Focused decision that interrupts the current task.
examples.behavior: Use for decisions that need explicit confirmation before continuing.
examples.qa: Primary and secondary actions are clearly ordered.

examples.title: Blocked action
examples.description: Modal content explains why the action cannot proceed.
examples.behavior: Keep the user in context and provide a route to inspect the blocker.
examples.qa: Error copy describes the blocker, not just a generic failure.

examples.title: Disabled primary
examples.description: Primary action waits for prerequisite input or policy.
examples.behavior: Disable only the unsafe action; keep cancel/close available.
examples.qa: User can still exit the modal.

default.qa: Focus and action order are clear.
